acceptanceCriteria: A manifest can name a second repository root by alias for tests (and may itself live in either declared root), and the map pins every root's revision; an unavailable or dirty second root yields UNKNOWN/refusal, never a silent partial join.
Single-root manifests and maps are unchanged (byte-identical outputs on existing fixtures).
Maintained tests cover the two-root join and the failure modes; the AMAP spec records the contract.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#669 part 2, filed 2026-10-07. The appmap manifest must be tracked in --root and tests.root must be under the same root; a common layout keeps routers in the product repo and Playwright specs and page objects in a separate E2E repo, so one map cannot join them, and the product repo cannot carry the manifest. Asks: tests.root naming a second root by alias as multi-root MCP (MMR-V0) does, each root's revision pinned in the map; or an untracked manifest bound by its SHA-256. Versions: corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 (build 360); corvint-tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.202; reporter on main-0b5096c, macOS arm64.
